_how: Klaudia's News has a FIXED board: seven shots on the four parts of the lyric (intro · verse · chorus · outro), so the person only approves it. klaudia_board.py plan --template news fills the seconds from the song. Fill each 'graphic' with an object that EXPLAINS that part's fact (kit/graphics.json): numbers → counter or meter, money or a list → ticket or tag, a deadline → clock, growth → chart, the news itself → alert or headline. Sung shots: close or medium, face to camera, mouth fully visible.

shots.what: close-up, she sings the hook to camera, deadpan
medium, she acts fact 1 (points, reads a phone, shrugs)
wide, she and the robots dance on the beat (the choir shouts)
medium close, she reacts to fact 2 with a straight face
medium close-up, she sings the chorus to camera
wide, low angle, full dance with the robots
close-up, the punchline, dry, she wins
